svg.title: Backup and verification engine connections
svg.desc: Inputs, outputs, durable state, evidence, failure, and recovery relationships for Backup and verification engine.

a.xlink:title: Backup, restore, and checkpoint state. Stores backup manifests, recovery operations, current state, database backups/restores, and restore checkpoints.
Backup and verification engine. Creates and verifies local encrypted backups through backend/worker-owned operations.
Completion and audit evidence. Records sanitized lifecycle and completion evidence for commands, devices, apps, security, recovery, and releases.
Restore preview and confirmed restore. Builds a non-destructive preview, requires explicit confirmation, creates a checkpoint, applies restore, and validates health.
Worker process. Consumes durable commands and owns backend execution for apps, security, recovery, releases, and lifecycle work.
